subnets.description: For representing services on the public internet, like DNS servers, cloud providers, or SaaS applications, that your network depends on but wouldn't be found by scanning. Create ip_addresses on this subnet to include them in your topology.
subnets.name: Internet

subnets.description: For representing services on networks outside your scan range, like branch offices, VPN endpoints, or remote infrastructure. Create ip_addresses on this subnet to include them in your topology.
subnets.name: Remote Network
